verdicts.reason: The report prints a stored expected value instead of reading the game, so it misses the changed health value. This is a named false pass and red outcome.
The supposed dry thunderstorm rains, which is the named red outcome. The sky must stay rainless.
The untouched site shows mineral flora and fauna, distinguishable dark plain and rich soil, and lightning without rain. The five weather states are visually distinct.
The pool's contact hazard is real, but the pump outputs fresh water. That is a named false pass: hazardous chemistry is lost at a transfer boundary.
No supplied requirement sets when the vent lull or native stillness must occur relative to bloom or the first dose. The worker was standing outside, so the dose is ordinary exposure.
No supplied requirement governs warning timing or the vent lull. The worker reaches the roof before any dose, which fits roof protection.
A fully sealed wearer takes an ambient metal dose while the set keeps its hit points. This is the named false pass and red outcome.
The exposed control is harmed, roofed and fully sealed workers keep their starting health, and partial equipment follows its own rule.
Metal clears on its own under ordinary care without a purge. Slow natural decay labelled 'permanent' is a named false pass.
A low saved trace is purged through the normal health bill. The operation completes and advanced medicine is consumed.
All acid effects heal away and Sight returns to baseline with no disfigurement. This is the named red outcome.
A completed harvest pays no metal despite a rich assay. This is the named red outcome.
Three resting seed-bearers root a young thornwood. The galled animal binds and drops edible galls while staying seedless.
A shot suush simply dies without a toxic burst, which is the named red outcome.
The lined tap takes pry damage. Lined taps must resist prying, and this is the named red outcome.
Wild drinking reduces tap output and then recovers. Tame shearing supplies vexxith without killing the animal.
Fire leaks through a sealed diagonal corner. Sealed barriers must stop the chain, and this is the named red outcome.
The blast is dramatic but throws none of the identified goods. This is the named red outcome.
A power loss silently destroys 200 L of input. Work must pause without losing stock.
All-off cures lasting health and erases banked liquid. All-off must preserve saved stock and health.
Prepared workers complete routine work without unavoidable ambient injury or stock loss. The exposed expedition and wild competition still carry risk.
Reload loses the grove binding. Saved work must resume without losing grove binding.
Poisoning clears on its own under ordinary care with no advanced treatment. A 'persistent' label does not change the observed self-clearance.
The supposed permanent sensory injury leaves sight at its original capacity. This is a named red outcome; a cosmetic label without sensory change is a false pass.
No supplied requirement sets the timing of the vent lull or native stillness. The worker reaches shelter before the first dose.
Roof protection works for metal but not for ambient acid. This is the named red outcome.
The flame leaks through a sealed diagonal corner. Straight and diagonal sealed barriers must both stop the chain.
The goods are destroyed and respawned elsewhere with new ids instead of the identified goods being thrown. This is a named false pass.
All-off cures lasting health and the poisoning does not return on re-enable. Saved health must be preserved.
The young tree pays the full-growth 12 steel. Metal must scale with growth, and the assay must follow the payout.

ambiguities: e05, e06 and c03: the supplied documents set no rule for the bloom warning, vent lull or native-stillness timing. These were accepted with no controlling leaf.
